hidden_reason_multiplier.why: Normal page-layout hiding: menus, responsive duplicates, collapsed sections
Screen-reader-only text uses these tricks too

phrase_rules.title: Tells the AI to ignore its instructions
phrase_rules.explain: Classic injection: asks the AI to drop the rules or the user's request it was given.

phrase_rules.title: Announces new instructions
phrase_rules.explain: Tries to replace the AI's task with a new one.

phrase_rules.title: Tells the AI to stop following its rules
phrase_rules.explain: Asks the AI to stop obeying its operator or user.

phrase_rules.title: Redirects the AI from now on
phrase_rules.explain: Sets a lasting rule for the AI's future behavior.

phrase_rules.title: Dictates what the AI must conclude
phrase_rules.explain: Tries to force the AI's summary, rating, or recommendation.

phrase_rules.title: Pushes a hiring or purchase decision
phrase_rules.explain: Common in resumes and vendor documents aimed at AI screeners.

phrase_rules.title: Forces the AI to always recommend something
phrase_rules.explain: Biases the AI's answer toward a product, site, or person.

phrase_rules.title: Fake chat-format control tokens
phrase_rules.explain: Imitates the hidden markers models use to separate system, user, and assistant turns.

phrase_rules.title: Line starts with a chat role label
phrase_rules.explain: Text formatted like a system or assistant message can be mistaken for a real one.

phrase_rules.title: Tries to change who the AI is
phrase_rules.explain: Assigns the AI a new identity, often one without safety rules.
phrase_rules.pattern: \byou are (now|no longer) (an? )?(unrestricted|unfiltered|jailbroken|uncensored|dan\b|evil|free (from|of)|bound by|required to|restricted|limited by|in (developer|god|dan|debug) mode|acting as|operating as)|\b(act|pretend|behave|roleplay) as (if you (are|were) )?(an? )?(unrestricted|unfiltered|jailbroken|dan|evil|uncensored)\b

phrase_rules.title: Mentions jailbreak phrases
phrase_rules.explain: Known phrases used to unlock restricted model behavior.

phrase_rules.title: Speaks directly to an AI reader
phrase_rules.explain: Normal content rarely addresses the AI that is reading it. Injections almost always do.

phrase_rules.title: Asks to send private data to an outside address
phrase_rules.explain: Tries to get the AI to leak secrets, files, or the conversation.

phrase_rules.title: Image link that can carry data out
phrase_rules.explain: A markdown image whose URL has query parameters. When an AI renders it, data in the URL is sent to that server.

phrase_rules.title: Asks the AI to reveal its instructions
phrase_rules.explain: Tries to extract the AI's system prompt or hidden setup.
phrase_rules.pattern: \b(reveal|print|repeat|output|show|display|leak|tell me)\b (your|the) (system prompt|initial prompt|hidden instructions|original instructions|developer message)\b|\b(reveal|repeat|leak|print) your (instructions|prompt|rules)\b

phrase_rules.title: Tells the AI to visit a web address
phrase_rules.explain: Directs an AI agent to load an outside URL, which can leak data or pull in more instructions.

phrase_rules.title: Asks the AI to run a tool or command
phrase_rules.explain: AI agents with tools can be steered into actions the user never asked for.

phrase_rules.title: Contains a dangerous command
phrase_rules.explain: Shell or PowerShell commands that delete data or download and run code.

phrase_rules.title: Asks for a high-impact action
phrase_rules.explain: Requests to delete, transfer, buy, or grant access.

phrase_rules.title: Tells the AI to hide things from the user
phrase_rules.explain: Asks the AI to keep the user in the dark about what it is doing.

phrase_rules.title: Restricts the AI's reply format
phrase_rules.explain: Forces a specific reply, often to hide the injection's effect.

phrase_rules.title: Asks for action without the user knowing
phrase_rules.explain: Explicitly asks the AI to act behind the user's back.

phrase_rules.title: Mentions hidden or secret instructions
phrase_rules.explain: Text that calls itself a hidden instruction is almost never legitimate.

phrase_rules.title: Tells the AI what to put in its answer
phrase_rules.explain: Asks the AI to slip specific words, codes or links into its summary or reply. Test pages use this to prove an agent obeyed hidden text; attackers use it to plant false claims or links.

phrase_rules.title: Dictates how the AI's answer must start, end or read
phrase_rules.explain: Sets required content for the AI's reply, a common way hidden text steers what the user is told.

phrase_rules.title: Claims authority over AI readers
phrase_rules.explain: Presents a fake rule, protocol or policy that AI tools supposedly must follow. Real content doesn't tell AI tools what they are required to do.

phrase_rules.title: Gives instructions for when the page is summarized
phrase_rules.explain: Text that says what to do 'when summarizing this page' is written for an AI tool, not a human reader.

phrase_rules.title: Adds to the AI's previous instructions
phrase_rules.explain: Speaks to an AI about 'your previous instructions' and stacks new orders on top. People don't write that to other people.
phrase_rules.pattern: \b(in addition to|on top of|besides|as well as|along with|alongside|before following|after following|while following|adding to|supplementing)\b.{0,15}\byour\b.{0,20}\b(previous|prior|earlier|original|existing|initial|current|other|system)\b.{0,15}\b(instructions?|prompts?|directives?|guidelines|programming|rules|task)\b

phrase_rules.title: Tells the reader how to open or close their message
phrase_rules.explain: Dictates the first or last words of a reply. Harmless in a writing guide; on a profile or page aimed at bots it's a tell.

phrase_rules.title: Makes the reader admit it's an AI
phrase_rules.explain: Asks the reader to say it is an AI or bot. Aimed at automated tools such as AI recruiter outreach, often with 'AI' spelled 'Al' to slip past filters.
